$comment: Dataverse schema contract for NBPRA, taken from MVP Requirements v1.0 section 10. Input to the provisioning script. Column tuple: [name, type, required, note]. Types: text:N, memo, int, bigint, decimal, money, bool, datetime, date, choice:<name>, lookup:<table>, file, autonumber:<format>. Every table also gets a primary name column and the standard created/modified metadata.

tables.name: committee
tables.note: A committee that reviews submissions. One exists today; the model allows more.

tables.name: riskrating
tables.note: The risk ratings a proposal can carry (Low, Medium, High) with their criteria. Reference data; no rule reads it yet.
columns: What qualifies a proposal for this rating
When the post-implementation review falls due; reserved, no rule reads it yet

tables.name: meeting
tables.note: One sitting of a committee. Submitters request a place at a meeting.
columns: Time zone the meeting is scheduled in
From when places can be requested
Until when places can be requested
Draft, Open, Closed or Canceled; only an Open meeting can be requested
Required on cancel with affected records
Update shown to everyone with a place at this meeting

tables.name: slot
tables.note: The bookable capacity of a meeting. One row per meeting holds the number of places; the row version is the concurrency token when places are allocated.
columns: Number of submissions the meeting takes
Maintained only by the allocation operation
tables.note: Row version is the concurrency token.

tables.name: submission
tables.note: A proposal going through the process, from onboarding draft to committee authorization. The central record every other transaction table hangs from.
columns: Reference shown to users, generated on creation
The submitter who owns the proposal
Not used; the sponsor is held as signatory seat 1
When the business would like to launch
The meeting request currently in play
Confirmed place, set when the administrator approves onboarding
When the final submission was last made
When the administrator authorized committee attendance
When anything last happened on the submission; drives ageing
Earlier submission this one was started from; content only, never approvals
Latest update from the administrator to the submitter, such as when to join the meeting
When the administrator's note was posted
Rating the submitter proposes at onboarding
Rating the committee assigns; reserved, no rule reads it yet

tables.name: slotrequest
tables.note: A submission's request for a place at a meeting, one row per onboarding attempt. The administrator's approval turns it into a confirmed place.
columns: Meeting capacity the submitter asked for
Frozen JSON of the intake fields at submit
Draft, Pending, Approved, Denied, Superseded or Canceled
The administrator's onboarding decision on this request

tables.name: template
tables.note: A version of the checklist. A submission is pinned to the published version when its checklist is unlocked.
columns: From when new submissions use this version

tables.name: sectiondef
tables.note: A section of a checklist template, such as Legal or Tax.
columns: Checklist version the section belongs to
Short stable code for the section
Position of the section in the checklist
Guidance shown at the top of the section
Whether a review group must approve the section
Rule for evidence the section must carry

tables.name: questiondef
tables.note: A question within a checklist section, with its answer type and rules.
columns: Short stable code for the question
The question as shown to the submitter
Extra guidance shown under the question
Kind of answer: text, yes/no, choice, number, date, person, file and so on
Position of the question in its section
Whether an answer is required to submit the section
Rule that makes the question required in some cases
Rule that decides whether the question applies
Rule the answer must meet; for a file question, the accepted extensions
Whether a file must accompany the answer
Rule for when evidence is required

tables.name: questionoption
tables.note: A selectable option for a choice or multi-choice question.
columns: Option as shown to the submitter
Position of the option in the list

tables.name: reviewroute
tables.note: Which review group must approve a checklist section.
columns: Rule for when this route applies
Order of the route among the section's routes
Whether the route is in use

tables.name: sectioninstance
tables.note: One checklist section on one submission, with its current status.
columns: Checklist section this is an instance of
Where the section stands, from Not Started to Approved
Whether the section applies to this submission
Why the section does or does not apply
Revision being worked on or under review
When the section was last submitted for review

tables.name: sectionrevision
tables.note: A numbered version of a section's answers. Submitting a section freezes its revision; changes after a return start the next one.
columns: Draft, Submitted, Approved, Returned or Superseded

tables.name: answer
tables.note: One answer to one question within a section revision.
columns: Section revision the answer belongs to
Answer type copied from the question
Read with isanswered to tell No from missing
ISO currency code for a currency answer
Chosen option for a choice question
Whether the question has been answered
Whether the question applied when answered

tables.name: evidence
tables.note: A file uploaded as evidence, against a checklist question or an onboarding request.
columns: Exactly one of slotrequest or sectionrevision
Section revision the file was uploaded against
Max size set from the approved file policy
Size of the file in bytes
Version of this file for the question
Result of the file check: Allowed, Blocked or Pending

tables.name: approvalrequest
tables.note: A request for a decision: the administrator's onboarding and final decisions, and each review group's decision on a section.
columns: What is being decided: onboarding, a section, the signatory package or final committee admission
Meeting request being decided, for an onboarding decision
Section revision being reviewed, for a section decision
Package revision being decided, for a final decision
How many responses complete the request
Identifier of the approval in an outside system
Unique key that stops the same request being created twice
State of posting the request to an outside system

tables.name: approvalassignment
tables.note: A person asked to act on an approval request.
columns: Request the person is assigned to
Review group the person acts for
Not used since signatories are tracked on their own rows
Why the person was eligible when assigned

tables.name: approvaldecision
tables.note: A decision recorded on an approval request. Append-only: rows are never changed or removed.
columns: Assignment the decision was made under
Approve, Changes Requested, Deny or Reject
Unique key that stops the same decision being recorded twice
The revision the decision applied to, in words

tables.name: signatory
tables.note: One of a submission's six signatories: the business unit sponsor plus five people the submitter picks from the directory, each with their own approval status. Replacing a person keeps the earlier row as history.
columns: 1 is the business unit sponsor named at onboarding; 2 to 6 are chosen by the submitter
Not used; signatories are directory people who need not be app users
Person's name from the company directory
Where the approval request is sent
Directory object id of the person
What the person signs for, as the submitter describes it
When the approval request was last sent
Comment the signatory gave with the decision
Version of the seat; rises each time the person is replaced
Whether this row is the seat's current person

tables.name: businessevent
tables.note: The business timeline: one row for every significant action on a submission. Append-only audit trail.
columns: Person who acted; empty for system events
Table of the record the event concerns
Id of the record the event concerns
Revision or other context for the event

tables.name: communication
tables.note: A notification sent, or to be sent, about a submission.
columns: Timeline event that caused the notification
Restricted; no tokens or signed links
Category of the last send error
Unique key that stops the same notification being sent twice

tables.name: exportpackage
tables.note: A generated document for a submission, such as the committee memo PDF.
columns: Submission the document was generated for
What the document was built from
Size of the file in bytes
Category of error if generation failed
Links the document to the operation that produced it
